levels.name: Git Init Master
levels.description: Initialize a new Git repository in the current directory
levels.task: Use git init to create a new repository

levels.name: Stage Everything
levels.description: Stage all files in the current directory for commit
levels.task: Use git add to stage all files

levels.name: First Commit
levels.description: Create your first commit with the message 'Initial commit'
levels.task: Use git commit with a message

levels.name: Check Status
levels.description: Check the current status of your repository
levels.task: Use git status to see repository state

levels.name: View History
levels.description: View the commit history of your repository
levels.task: Use git log to see commit history

levels.name: Create Branch
levels.description: Create a new branch called 'feature'
levels.task: Use git branch to create a new branch

levels.name: Switch Branch
levels.description: Switch to the 'feature' branch
levels.task: Use git checkout to switch branches

levels.name: Merge Branches
levels.description: Merge the 'feature' branch into the current branch
levels.task: Use git merge to combine branches

levels.name: Delete Branch
levels.description: Delete the 'feature' branch after merging
levels.task: Use git branch -d to delete a branch

levels.name: Remote Add
levels.description: Add a remote repository called 'origin' with URL 'https://github.com/user/repo.git'
levels.task: Use git remote add to connect to a remote repository

levels.name: Push to Remote
levels.description: Push your commits to the remote repository
levels.task: Use git push to upload commits to remote

levels.name: Pull Changes
levels.description: Pull the latest changes from the remote repository
levels.task: Use git pull to download remote changes

levels.name: Stash Changes
levels.description: Temporarily save your uncommitted changes
levels.task: Use git stash to save work in progress

levels.name: Apply Stash
levels.description: Apply the most recent stashed changes
levels.task: Use git stash pop to restore stashed changes

levels.name: Reset Hard
levels.description: Reset your working directory to match the last commit (WARNING: destroys uncommitted changes)
levels.task: Use git reset --hard to discard all changes

levels.name: Rebase Interactive
levels.description: Start an interactive rebase of the last 3 commits
levels.task: Use git rebase -i to rewrite commit history

levels.name: Cherry Pick
levels.description: Apply a specific commit from another branch
levels.task: Use git cherry-pick to apply a specific commit

levels.name: Submodule Add
levels.description: Add a Git submodule to your repository
levels.task: Use git submodule add to include another repository

levels.name: Blame File
levels.description: Show who modified each line of a file
levels.task: Use git blame to see line-by-line history

levels.name: Bisect Start
levels.description: Start a binary search to find which commit introduced a bug
levels.task: Use git bisect to find problematic commits
